title: taraxacum autumnale
intro: Taraxacum autumnale, commonly known as autumn dandelion or autumnal dandelion, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting liver function. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum autumnale include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Taraxacum autumnale include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
